desc:
Battlegrounds combat fighting with SMOOTH slicing!
Slice players! Destroy objects! Master weapons!

Smooth Slicing is a physics combat game where every hit feels satisfying!

⚔️ Choose your weapon:
Katana - Rapier - Great Sword - Fists - Spell Book - Spear - Battle Axe - Daggers

🏆 THE DUEL UPDATE:
* NEW Duel Server: duel anyone on your own rules, or watch live duels
* NEW weapons: Battle Axe and Daggers
* NEW Weapon Mastery: level up every weapon for skins and titles
* Feats, titles and leaderboards to chase
* Redesigned menus, heavier hits and smoother performance

Play solo, duel enemies, relax with friends, or create chaos in free private servers!

Join the community server for clans, events, and updates!

→ Roblox Plus users receive the Weapon Customization pass for free!
